capabilities.summary: Scenes declare decoded audio resources and narration/effects/music cues on scene time; hosts play them through a reconciling AudioSession and export the same mix offline.
restrictions: Wire stays 0.2. Scenes and programs gate with requiredCapabilities / requires containing audio.cues; audio resources or cues without it are rejected.

Resources declare href and decoded durationMs; readiness is host-reported. Cues use root scene time, buses narration/effects/music, offset/duration inside the resource, loops 1..1000, gain 0..4, linear fades; at most 4096 cues.

Scene time is the master clock (docs/decisions/engine/audible-media-clock.md): audio is silent unless playing at a rate in [0.5, 2]; voices re-seek beyond 40 ms error; narration ducks effects/music by a step gain of 0.35.
Narration is required by default: pending required audio holds startup/playback and failed required audio blocks acceptance; optional cues are skipped with AUDIO_OPTIONAL_SKIPPED.

Cues may stream after the first seal (ADD_AUDIO_CUES) only when they start at or after the seal; audio resources are base definitions. No spatial audio, ducking ramps, per-cue rate or speech synthesis.

capabilities.summary: Scenes declare planar 2.5D layers: a camera and surfaces (root-scene nodes) with 3D placement, hinges and reverse-face control, projected at frame resolution.
restrictions: Wire stays 0.2. Scenes and programs gate with requiredCapabilities / requires containing space.planar25d; spatialLayers without it are rejected.

Each layer has one camera (perspective or orthographic, finite position/yaw/pitch/roll, positive focalLength/zoom/near when present) and surfaces naming root-scene nodes. A node is a surface of at most one layer; parents are surfaces of the same layer and may not form a cycle.
A hinge needs distinct from/to points in the parent surface's plane and a finite angle in radians. Layer ids are unique; at most 1024 surfaces per scene.

Layers are base definitions: they cannot be added after the first seal. AnimationRuntime and StreamingRuntime project declared layers through projectSpatialFrame on every evaluate; spatial diagnostics appear on lastDiagnostics. createSceneInputSession supplies dragPlaneDelta so dragTranslate on surfaces uses surfaceDragDelta. Animated spatial channels (surface z/rotations/hinge angle and spatial camera values as track targets) are outside this release.

capabilities.summary: Scenes declare one planar 2D physics world: dynamic rigid bodies/colliders/joints or authored distance constraints, with exclusive physics ownership of transform channels.
restrictions: Wire stays 0.2. Scenes and programs gate with requiredCapabilities / requires containing physics.planar2d; physics without it is rejected.

One world per scene. Dynamic mode needs bodies (circle/AABB colliders, optional distance joints); authored mode needs constraints and rejects joints. Body/joint limits match PhysicsSession defaults (256).
Physics exclusively owns transform.position.x/y and transform.rotation for each body entity; authored constraint endpoints own position.x/y. Tracks and input bindings on those scalars are rejected.

The world is a base definition on CREATE_SCENE, frozen after the first seal. Hosts lower with createScenePhysicsSession and apply writes as a SampleOverlay; AnimationRuntime stays pure. Drag handoff uses PhysicsSession beginDrag/dragTo/endDrag. No volumetric 3D, soft bodies, fluids or motors.

capabilities.summary: Planar 2.5D layers opt into seam/split compositing: true surface intersections are split along their plane intersection into ordered fragments, and declared seams are checked for a shared edge in view space.
restrictions: Wire stays 0.2. A spatial layer's seams object requires space.planarSeams (and space.planar25d) in requiredCapabilities / requires; without it the scene is rejected. Layers without seams keep the 0.12.0 report-only behaviour exactly.

seams: split (boolean, default true), edgeEpsilon (> 0, default 0.001 logical units), maxFragments (integer 0..1024, default 64 extra draw items per layer per frame), edges (pairs of distinct surfaces of the same layer, no duplicates).

Plane tests stay the occlusion authority. A pair whose outlines straddle each other's planes is clipped along the exact plane-plane line in item space; fragments keep node id, appearance and paint slot and are ordered by the same plane tests. Fragment paint outlines overlap the cut by 0.5 logical px to avoid anti-aliased hairlines. Text, image, open-outline and stroked surfaces are not split (SPATIAL_SPLIT_UNSUPPORTED) and over-budget pairs are left unsplit (SPATIAL_SPLIT_LIMIT); both keep SPATIAL_SURFACES_INTERSECT.

Declared seam edges report SPATIAL_SEAM_OPEN when the two projected outlines share no collinear overlapping edge within edgeEpsilon; geometric coincidence is required, not visual similarity. Shared edges never suppress an intersection. Order hints are a host option (projectSpatialFrame orderHint), applied to ties only; no authored or animated order channel is in this release.
